audit.why: 69.23% over 39 games (small sample) matches the prose: he takes level 1, the lane flips at 3 and stays Cassiopeia's through side lane and teamfights because his only way in is a telegraphed walk-down.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and the level 6 spike credits Stormbringer with a shield.
audit.why: Riot text: Stormbringer grants bonus Health and disables towers; the shield belongs to Sky Splitter (E), 'granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius'. Cooldowns: Q 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, E 16 flat, R 160/135/110.
audit.corrected: Moved the shield to Sky Splitter and anchored the spikes to Q's 12s rank-1 charge and R's 160s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. (a) 'the E (Major Mismatch) toss-displacement' is corrupted text describing an ability Volibear does not have — Sky Splitter (E) is a lightning bolt at a location that damages and slows, with a shield for him. (b) Every layer claims Miasma grounds his Thundering Smash approach. Thundering Smash is a move-speed buff into a stunning attack, not a movement ability; Riot's Miasma text only stops Movement abilities, and the only one Volibear has is Stormbringer (R).
audit.why: Riot text, Thundering Smash: 'Volibear gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks.' Miasma: 'Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities.' The kit file flags dash on R only.
audit.corrected: Named Sky Splitter correctly, and reassigned the grounding value to Stormbringer while telling you to lean on Miasma's slow against the Q walk-down.

audit.whatIsWrong: Frenzied Maul's healing is mentioned but never answered with Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Frenzied Maul is a 5-second cooldown that heals him on the second cast on the same target and applies on-hit, so his sustain scales with attack speed from The Relentless Storm — anti-heal, not armour, is the counter.
audit.corrected: Added anti-heal to the extended-trade advice.

audit.whatIsWrong: The early, mid and late paragraphs are written in the first person ('I have one ability', 'my Miasma').
audit.why: Every other matchup addresses the reader in the second person; the voice break reads as a draft that was never edited.
audit.corrected: Rewrote all three in the user's second-person voice.

edits.before: Your full kit is online: Noxious Blast (Q) primes, Twin Fang (E) refunds and nukes the poisoned target, and Miasma (W) grounds. Start W-grounding his Q approach so he can never close, then chain near-free Twin Fangs while your Q move-speed buff lets you kite backward.
edits.after: Your full kit is online: Noxious Blast (Q) primes, Twin Fang (E) refunds off the poisoned target, Miasma (W) grounds. Thundering Smash is a move-speed charge, not a dash, so the cloud will not cancel it — its slow will. Chain near-free Twin Fang and kite back on Q's speed buff.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze answers his all-in. When he charges Q to stun-engage or E-tosses you behind him to commit, turn and stun him with R, then chain Twin Fangs through his W self-heal before it ticks him back up.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze answers his all-in. He charges Thundering Smash (Q) to stun you and drops Sky Splitter (E) for the slow and his own shield — turn, stun him, then chain Twin Fang through the Frenzied Maul heal.

edits.before: If Miasma (W) is on cooldown when he engages, his Q stun-charge into E displacement plus W heal lets him brawl through your poison and dive you — that is the only window he kills you, so track your W timer religiously.
edits.after: With Miasma spent he can walk you down: Thundering Smash stuns off a 12s rank-1 charge, Sky Splitter shields him, and Frenzied Maul heals on every second cast into you — that is the one window he kills you.

edits.after: Save Miasma (W) for Stormbringer (R) — the leap is his only movement ability, so grounding kills it; against the Thundering Smash walk-down it is the cloud's slow that saves you

edits.after: Hold Petrifying Gaze (R) for his level 6 all-in and stun him out of the Stormbringer landing instead of burning it as poke

edits.before: Level 1 goes to him — I have one ability and no poison primed, while his Q charge-up auto and passive lifesteal autos chunk me if I step up, so I just last-hit and concede the level. It evens out at 2 once I can prime with Noxious Blast (Q) and answer with a Twin Fang (E), and at 3 the lane becomes mine: full kit online, plus my passive escalating move speed and Q's move-speed buff to kite. The whole early game is about my Miasma (W) — the second he charges Thundering Smash to gap-close, I drop the cloud to ground it, kill his approach, and strand him in poison while my Twin Fangs ramp.
edits.after: Level 1 goes to him — one ability, no poison primed, and his Thundering Smash charge-auto plus passive damage chunk you if you step up, so last-hit and concede it. It evens at 2 once you prime with Noxious Blast (Q) and answer with Twin Fang (E), and at 3 the lane is yours: full kit, Serpentine Grace, and Q's speed buff to kite on. Understand what Miasma does here — Thundering Smash is a move-speed charge, not a dash, so grounding will not cancel it. The cloud's slow is what breaks the walk-down. Save the grounding for Stormbringer later.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are my takeover. With ranks in Q and E I chain refunded Twin Fangs faster than his W self-heal can recover, and every time he charges Q at me I ground it with Miasma and kite backward at full move speed while my poison shreds him. At 6 his all-in looks scary on paper — Q stun-charge into E displacement into R shield and tower disable — but my Petrifying Gaze is the answer: I bait the commit, turn and stun him mid-dive, then E him out through his heal. Never waste W as poke here; it is my anti-engage button and his entire kit is built around reaching me.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are your takeover. Ranks in Q and E let you chain refunded Twin Fang faster than Frenzied Maul's 5-second heal can recover, and every Thundering Smash charge dies in the Miasma slow while you kite backward at full speed. At 6 his all-in reads scary — Q stun-charge, Sky Splitter's slow and shield, Stormbringer's bonus health and tower disable — but Petrifying Gaze is the answer: bait the commit, turn and stun him mid-leap, then Twin Fang him out through the heal. Grievous Wounds makes that last part stick.

edits.before: I keep this lane all game as long as I respect the one thing that kills me. Volibear scales into a tanky diver who stacks resistances, but Twin Fang's single-target nuke and my poison's percent-based ramp still shred him, so even a beefy front-to-back Voli melts once I land my Q-into-E combo. The real danger is getting caught with Miasma on cooldown: if he charges Q to stun me and E-displaces me while W is down, his self-heal and R shield let him brawl through my DPS and dive me. Play around my W timer, keep my Q move-speed buffer up, and he never gets a clean lock-on.
edits.after: You keep this lane all game if you respect the one thing that kills you. Volibear scales into a tanky diver, but Twin Fang's single-target nuke and your poison ramp still shred him, so even a front-to-back Voli melts once the Q-into-E combo lands. The danger is being caught with Miasma spent: Thundering Smash stuns you, Sky Splitter slows and shields him, and Frenzied Maul heals him through your DPS while he dives. Play around the W timer, keep Q's move-speed buffer up, and carry anti-heal — he never gets a clean lock-on.

edits.before: - Volibear Thundering Smash (Stun): matchup-defining — The run-down stun — make distance the moment he starts glowing. Check it before every step-up. - W Miasma is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Volibear Thundering Smash: matchup-defining — 12s at rank 1, the run-down stun; make distance the moment he glows. - Sky Splitter is 16s flat and shields him if he stands in it. - Miasma is saved for Stormbringer, his only movement ability, on 160s.
